prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Reference image is STYLE AND AA CHARACTER reference only. Create ONE production transparent square illustration overlay for a collectible drink stamp. Match the reference's rich hand-painted watercolor textures, warm brown sketch lines, layered pigments and lovely detailed drink illustration. Do NOT simplify into flat vector graphics. AA must be the SAME brown bob-haired chibi girl with rosy cheeks and cream floral blouse; show her full upper body and BOTH hands, expressive interaction. Layout EXACT: cup large on LEFT at x=12–51%, y=25–78%; AA upper body at x=57–85%, y=10–43%; ingredients clustered bottom-left x=10–53%, y=69–82%, and a tiny botanical accent upper-left. Keep x=57–88%, y=47–76% completely EMPTY transparent for live name/brand text. Keep bottom band y=85–100% empty transparent for date. All artwork stays inside 8–90% bounds. No frame, no badge, no backing paper, no white disc behind girl, no white sticker outlines, no background rectangle. TRUE alpha transparency around and between illustrated objects. White only inside milk/clothes/eyes. NO text, NO letters, NO signature, NO watermark. Rich visual detail that remains legible at stamp size. Subject: Mango pomelo sago milk tea, golden mango puree, cream marbling, translucent sago, diced mango and pink pomelo; girl happily holding a mango slice
